## Problem / opportunity

The source process audit found 49.0% first-pass plan review and a p90 of eight attempts. That is meaningful churn, but the project already has a mature deterministic pre-LLM floor: current code implements P1-P11. A proposal framed as "add deterministic preflight" would duplicate existing architecture and risk promoting noisy heuristics.

## Prior decisions that constrain this idea

elfin-floor-gouge established the deterministic tier as the default blocking layer and semantic LLM review as the architecture/context layer. depleted-lethal-brownbear promoted P10/P11 only after pass/block backtests demonstrated discrimination and low false-positive rates; it rejected spec-by-example and riskiest-assumption blockers because they did not discriminate. childsafe-bizarre-lorikeet found that criterion-skipping on revised plans is unsafe: 37% of 894 revisions blocked on a criterion absent from the first block. It separately identified identical-material re-reviews as a quality-neutral optimization target.

This idea must extend the existing floor rather than build a parallel preflight or weaken semantic review.

## Outcome hypothesis

Persisted plan-review and completion sidecars can reveal a small Pareto set of recurrent, mechanically decidable failure classes. Replay-tested candidates may reduce avoidable LLM churn without increasing false blocks or hiding cross-cutting findings.

## Guardrails

- Candidate checks must be mechanically decidable from evidence available before the LLM review.
- Unsupported or uncertain grounding fails open and records coverage.
- No criterion-skipping based only on unchanged-looking plan sections.
- No promotion directly from intuition to blocking; use offline replay and an advisory observation period.
- Preserve semantic review for architecture, failure modes, portability, testing strategy, and tradeoffs.
- Optimize total review quality/cost, not PASS rate in isolation.

## Questions before promotion

- What is the Pareto distribution of blocking findings by normalized failure class and remediation?
- Which classes can be decided deterministically with pre-review material?
- What pass/block cohorts and sampling method establish a false-positive ceiling?
- What precision/recall and minimum support thresholds justify advisory rollout and later blocking?
- How will abstention, unsupported stacks, and stale grounding be represented?
- Which identical-material rerun causes can be eliminated without changing review coverage?
- What guard metrics ensure completion quality and defect signals do not worsen?

## Evidence

Discovered from unpleasing-hairy-yellowlegs; source audit bleakish-stational-cob. Prior work: elfin-floor-gouge, depleted-lethal-brownbear, papyral-scarlet-malamute, childsafe-bizarre-lorikeet, big-mammalian-bronco.
